question.text: The velocity-time graph for a body of mass 10 kg is shown in the figure. Work done on the body in the first two seconds of motion is

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & V=-\frac{50}{10} t+50 \\ & V=50-5 t \\ & \text { at } t=2 \mathrm{~s} \\ & V=50-10=40 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}\end{aligned}$ $\begin{aligned} & W=k_f-k_i \\ & \frac{1}{2} \times 10\left(40^2-50^2\right]=-\frac{1}{2} \times 10[90 \times 10] \\ & =-4500 \mathrm{~J}\end{aligned}$
